pre_result_units:
# Result-blind whole observation units

The primary stratum is LMR ON/depth_rank, evaluated separately for BEST43 NNUE and fixed D. LMR OFF is secondary. Each stratum has the original six O/M/P/P/M/O native passes, sixteen calls and eight cold-to-warm sessions per pass. No result has been collected for431.

The whole pass is the originating guardian's actual native child wall_seconds, after verifying its command/process identity, direct reap and complete capture. It includes native startup, input/model/setup, session reset, both searches, distance/history/counters, journals, teardown/drop and final publication. The native whole_before_result_publication_seconds and whole_driver_seconds are nested explanatory clocks, not replacements or additional summands. Missing whole receipts remain UNKNOWN.

For root-specific whole units, use the same native pass and its eight actual sessions. For each root, sum its two root_body_including_journal_seconds plus its recorded reset and final teardown seconds. Those reset/teardown entries are outside the call-body clock. Let shared residual equal the native child wall minus the sum of these eight session bodies. Allocate exactly one eighth of this shared residual to each root session. Thus all eight root whole units sum to the measured pass whole, including shared input/model/setup/drop/publication and process overhead. A missing stage, negative residual or mismatched session makes this allocation UNKNOWN; do not clamp or substitute Search time. This is a fixed equal accounting allocation, not an independently measured causal cost for each root.

For cold/warm presentation, assign actual reset to cold and teardown to warm, then one sixteenth of the same shared residual to each call. Present direct call-body and Search clocks alongside these allocated whole values. Do not sum nested elapsed clocks, infer isolated method/history/map costs, or treat the allocation as a counterfactual timing experiment.

The predeclared practical check uses pass whole medians of the two repetitions of each method: P <= M and P <= O. For every fixed root, compare both P root-session whole allocations to the corresponding two-repetition control median. Both P repetitions above 1.10 times either M or O control median fails that root check. Unknown or unfinished observations remain explicit and do not support retention. Show unallocated clocks and raw root bodies so this accounting choice remains inspectable.

The eight original true-prefix roots, models, depth8, 4M nodes/call, no time limit, cold/warm pairing, order and total384-call cap are unchanged. No extra warmup, refill, diagnostic callback or post-result threshold choice is authorized.
